analysis.overall: You spent 90% of the day in range with a great average of 106 mg/dL, though the day was marked by steep drops into low territory after dinner and late morning.

events.title: Post-dinner low
events.description: Following a 45g carb dinner and full meal bolus at 9:30 PM, glucose dropped rapidly to 63 mg/dL and hovered low for nearly an hour.

events.title: Morning dip from stacked corrections
events.description: Multiple small correction boluses given between 7:25 AM and 8:00 AM pulled your glucose down to 68 mg/dL right before breakfast.

events.title: Breakfast peak and fast drop
events.description: Breakfast pushed your readings up to the daily high of 171 mg/dL before active insulin and corrections triggered a rapid drop back down to 59 mg/dL by noon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking correction boluses when glucose is hovering around 110-120 mg/dL, as it led to steep drops twice today.
